horoscope: There can be a strong desire, or sudden need, to do something productive on the home front or with family today, dear Aries. You are in the mood to make something happen, to push something forward, and to solve problems that leave you feeling that you're ahead of the game. You may feel the urge to rearrange or reorganize your setup or living arrangements. Don't overdo it, and keep an eye on your energy levels and capabilities so you keep everything fun and productive. You are especially aware of the details required to get a job done, and this helps you make a dent in what you pursue today. You're confident that you can take on a challenge, and ideas for work or health are especially fertile today and tomorrow. It can be satisfying to offer your practical support.

This can be a great time for feeling supported, nurtured, and peaceful, dear Taurus, although it’s not simply coming to you–you’re working for it! With today's Sun-Mars transit, it's a time for being stimulated, engaged, and ready to take action. Right now, your focus seems to be on personal matters, healing energies, and positive reinforcement. Your energy levels are high today, and your powers to persuade, lead, and influence are strong. It’s a great time to share your high spirits with others and watch for the opportunities that open up as you do. Romantic intensity of the pleasant variety may figure strongly, but you’re also engaged mentally. Talking, chatting, and sharing are active forces in your life now. Incoming information or news can be exciting, or it might move something forward. Your enthusiasm for your projects, creations, and ideas is front and center. You are interested in triumphing, bringing something to a new level, or taking the lead.

Your desire for action is a pleasant motivator today, dear Gemini, prompting you to get going on a business or financial matter. You’re ready to solve problems, and while you are perfectly capable of getting things done on your own, enlisting others’ help can be beneficial now. You could be working to make your home life more secure or more fulfilling, and you’re willing to put in the necessary effort. Even though your emotional fuse can be a little short, your desire to come out on top is strong and is likely to keep you going. You could also find yourself in a good position to acquire something coveted, potentially home- or comfort-related. One of the best things about today’s Sun-Mars energy is that you concern yourself less with others’ validation or approval and more with fulfilling your needs and desires.

Things can be tying together nicely today, dear Cancer, with a Sun-Mars transit. You can feel pleasantly motivated. Reaching out to someone can be fruitful today. With Mars in your sign, you have more confidence and desire to take action, and the Sun adds punch and authority to your communications. Extend help, graciousness, and courtesies, and you may very well expand your world now. It's an excellent time for getting the word out if you are working on something special. While you're happy with others and cooperation is easy, you're far less dependent on others' approval, and this frees you up in wonderful ways this week. You could be excited to beat a personal best, as you want to improve and advance. You can be quite brave with your intelligence or ideas. Certainly, you're motivated and ready to take the initiative. There's also more energy in what you're saying, sharing, and doing today.

You're proactive today, dear Leo, dealing with problems before they get a chance to grow. This is due to a Sun-Mars transit. The need to overcome problem areas or get past something is dominant now, so take advantage. Solving problems is most creative at the moment, primarily because you have a unique perspective on them. You may feel a strong urge to do something out of the ordinary, perhaps driven by a desire for something valuable or to feel more secure and settled. There is also good energy with you to look at your finances. Others may be in the market or mood for your special talents. Your inner or private world is more animated than usual, and tapping into your inner courage and finding your passion can come more readily.

Decisiveness comes more readily today, dear Virgo. It looks like an excellent time to enjoy friends and perhaps meet someone special. You radiate warm vibes and may very well be the focus of attention or the one everyone’s talking about now. A Sun-Mars transit favors sharing some of your expertise with others, teaming up to get something done, or pursuing a long-standing dream. This is a time to inspire others and draw inspiration yourself. You’ll also find it more comfortable than usual to put plans or ideas into motion. You can quickly become fired up and emotionally behind a cause or movement, feeling a deep sense of passion and commitment. While it’s natural for you to go your own way without interference right now, cooperation also comes easily, and people seem supportive.

Your intuition can back you up today, particularly when making life path or career-related decisions, dear Libra, as you seem to have your finger on the pulse of what others currently want. You can easily draw on memory or wisdom to solve a problem or advance a goal. While you can be somewhat retiring personally, your ambition to triumph, succeed, or win is stirring right now. Do keep in mind that you are bound to bring out strong feelings and reactions in others, whether or not you intend to. You naturally take the lead or act independently at the moment, and your sense of where to go or what to do next is strong. Opportunities now can come from behind the scenes, or you may find much to enjoy in your private life.

You can find yourself in a unique position to expand your horizons today, dear Scorpio, as the Sun and Mars harmonize, both with each other and with your sign. Your friends and network can inspire and support you, making it easier to embrace new ideas and venture into uncharted territory. This is a time when you’re inclined to trust both the information you receive and your instincts. Your current motivation seems to magically refill your energy as you use it. It’s a great time for spontaneous activities, sharing ideas, networking, learning something new, or working towards a cherished dream or goal. This spontaneity leaves you feeling adventurous and open to new experiences. It’s also a good time for competitive play and doing things you enjoy. You might even find the courage to do something entirely different and enjoy an entirely unique experience. Today, your creative powers are in full swing.

A healthy, happy level of competitiveness can be energizing today, dear Sagittarius, and you can feel pleasantly motivated, as if you are turning a new page in your life. This is especially obvious when it comes to career, responsibilities, long-term goals, and life-path matters. You can be exceptionally resourceful today and might quickly solve a problem that had previously stumped you or uncover or attract a resource. You have a real desire to come out ahead, to triumph, or to accomplish something today. This can be an excellent time for professional success, especially with a bit of competition motivating you to advance. Gaining professional support or backing may be in the cards now. Instead, this energy may mean feeling eager to discover unique ways to manage your life.

With today's transits, you can experience a significant boost in your confidence and optimism, dear Capricorn. A harmonious aspect between the Sun and Mars brings a pleasant spice to your relationships. An empowering conversation or exchange of ideas may be part of the picture now. You can feel quite inspired by your connections. Someone special, perhaps a partner or a close friend, is supportive and intrigued by or invested in your point of view. When you reach out to others or step out of your comfort zone, you are more willing to take personal and creative risks today. This transit favors both competitive and cooperative activities, and you’re likely to feel that someone is encouraging you to be the best version of yourself. This supportive figure can help stir your enthusiasm and confidence. You are also investing quite a bit into others now, and together, you can accomplish much. The desire is to feel alive and vital, which can be achieved through relationships.

There can be a pleasantly demanding feel to your life today, dear Aquarius. Doing your best can be exciting as the Sun and Mars harmonize. You might act on an impulse, making a quick and possibly daring decision that propels you forward. You'll find practical solutions to problems today. You could benefit greatly from investigation or research. It's time to add a little extra oomph to, or change, lifeless routines, chores, or duties. You're not inclined to be told what to do, so aim for something that lets you work at your own pace. An independent pace may be more productive now, in fact, as it allows you to work on inspiration and enthusiasm. You want to excel and advance. Providing a service or helping someone can be rewarding.

With today's Sun-Mars transit, dear Pisces, you may enjoy a vital creative or romantic connection and a confidence boost. Cooperation is key right now, but some playful competitiveness also works and may nudge you to do your best. Your feelings and connections are spicier, or you're ready to put yourself out there, and your natural charm is incredibly endearing. You crave activities where you can create, compete, or play, and you can be excited to take the lead in a relationship, romance, recreational activity, or hobby. Instead, you want to move forward in these areas. You want to stand out for what you do or for being a great friend or partner. A relationship may motivate you to better yourself or do your best.
